subject.title: fix(ui): keep sidebar selection on archived sessions and replace the composer with an archived notice

question: Should this PR receive a proof override, or should it provide real Control UI evidence for archive, refresh, and unarchive before merge?
rationale: The available screenshots and E2E output use mocked gateway fixtures; repository policy treats tests and mocks as supplemental rather than real behavior proof for an external PR.

options.title: Request live UI proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted real Control UI run that archives the selected session, observes the refresh, and unarchives it in place.

options.title: Grant an evidence override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the mocked-gateway coverage if real local UI proof is impractical and the remaining risk is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Request live UI proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted real Control UI run that archives the selected session, observes the refresh, and unarchives it in place.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor owns the available branch evidence and is best positioned to provide an after-fix Control UI recording or redacted live output.
